title: Mark Tilbury Economics: U.S. Debt and Mortgage Rates: Tilbury’s Bond Market Warning
description:
Original video author: Mark Tilbury Economics. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. U.S. debt and mortgage rates are linked in Mark Tilbury Economics’ video, “The First Domino in the US Debt Crisis.” This recap covers the channel’s debt and interest-cost claims, weaker demand across four groups of Treasury buyers, higher yields and bond-price risk, the rising term premium, and buybacks it says failed to sustainably lower borrowing costs, ending with its reported 5.3% auction yield.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#MarkTilburyEconomics #TheFirstDominointheUSDebtCrisis #USdebtcrisisexplained #Treasurybondyieldsexplained #nationaldebtinterestpayments
tags: The First Domino in the US Debt Crisis
music_mood: light rhythmic instrumental groove, warm keys, crisp soft percussion, curious and approachable, steady moderate energy, no ominous tension, no sirens or trailer impacts
hook: Mark Tilbury Economics says America is borrowing just to pay interest.
reporter_prompt: Five-second horizontal opening featuring a middle-aged American male reporter in a navy blazer outside the U.S. Treasury Building in Washington, DC, with the actual Treasury facade clearly visible. Natural late-afternoon light, conversational delivery, calm curiosity, restrained gestures. This is independent commentary, not an impersonation of Mark Tilbury. Add graphics in postproduction only: charcoal panels, orange emphasis, white bold condensed typography, deep green comparison panels and sub
